name: Service agreements
summary: Service agreements for a health-care practice: each active patient case gets its agreement form queued for approval, then created unsent in the patient record; an agreement still unsigned after the set days gets an expiry queued for approval; a completed agreement is logged once to the register. Crons read and draft; nobody's agreement is sent by a cron, and a person approves every change a patient sees.

steps.agreement-trigger: partial: active patient cases drive the draft, not Cliniko's own form-on-booking placeholder (that setting is not read)
steps.template-select: cron: the agreement template id from settings
steps.fill-details: the patient fills in the form in Cliniko; not driven by the cron
steps.client-explain: person: the privacy policy section is built in the template
steps.sign: cron reads the signature on a completed form
steps.send-for-signature: person: Cliniko's API maps no send, so the form is sent from the patient record
steps.file-record: cron: completed agreement logged once to the register
steps.record-keeping: register in the kit store; Cliniko keeps the signed form

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: Active patient cases with no agreement yet: queue the agreement form for approval; once approved it is created unsent in the patient record.

crons.name: chase
crons.summary: Agreements unsigned after the set days: queue an expiry for approval (22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia).

crons.name: file-record
crons.summary: Completed agreements: log each once to the internal register.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads only. Creating an agreement form and expiring one both change what the patient can see, so both are live operations: a cron queues them and a person approves each one.

cliniko.covers: active patient case to unsent agreement form, expiry of an unsigned form (approval), signed-form record to the register

gaps: Cliniko: the API maps no send for a patient form. A person sends the created form from the patient record by email, SMS, QR code or link.
Cliniko: a rejected form creation is not queued again, so that patient case gets no agreement until someone starts it by hand in Cliniko.
Cliniko: the 21-day clock starts when the form is created (when a person approves the creation), not when a person sends it to the patient. Needs a sent date set in the CRM shell (shell change).
Cliniko: the chase reminder is manual for the same reason. The only automated change is the expiry, which waits for approval.
Cliniko: the trigger is every active patient case. Confirm with the owner that each one needs an agreement, or narrow the trigger before going live.
Cliniko: list replies are read as one page (up to 100 active cases per run). Larger caseloads need paging added.
Cliniko: the signature id is read from the form's signatures list. The field is in the official schema, but the item's id field is inferred from the signature path; confirm on a live account.
Cliniko: authentication is from the vendor docs only (basic auth with CLINIKO_API_KEY). Nothing has been run against a real account.
Cliniko: whether a form moves from sent to completed, and how a signed copy is kept long term, need a live account to confirm.
Cliniko: rates-check, plan manager or funder sending, renewal dates and end-of-agreement handling are not covered by the docs read.

Halaxy: only one general marketing page was read. It describes no agreements, forms or signatures, and no ops file is mapped, so no Halaxy adapter was built. Its help-centre pages on forms, consent and invoicing need reading first.
DocuSign and PandaDoc are mapped in the kit, but no platform docs for this workflow name them, so no adapter was built for them.
Confirm the workflow steps and platform coverage with the business before enabling its crons.
